entries.05446f20600a7332: This is a reportable segment that provides solutions optimizing the entire global supply chain of corporate customers by combining international forwarding, international express, contract logistics overseas and other services. Yamato Transport Co., Ltd., Kobe Yamato Co., Ltd., Konan Kogyo Co., Ltd., YAMATO TRANSPORT U.S.A., INC., YAMATO TRANSPORT EUROPE B.V., YAMATO TRANSPORT (S) PTE. LTD., YAMATO TRANSPORT (M) SDN. BHD., Yamato Logistics Management (China) Co., Ltd., Yamato International Logistics Co., Ltd., Yamato Transport (Hong Kong) Co., Ltd., TAIWAN YAMATO INTERNATIONAL LOGISTICS INC. and others are responsible for the segment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥97,552 million (up 13.5% year on year). The breakdown is logistics support revenue of ¥134,774 million, transportation revenue of ¥6,243 million, other revenue of ¥4,560 million, and intersegment eliminations of −¥48,025 million. The company explains that the increase in revenue was due to progress in expanding international forwarding sales. Segment profit (operating profit) was ¥8,150 million, the largest among the reportable segments, a decrease of ¥877 million year on year. Segment assets were ¥62,100 million, and the number of employees was 2,770. The company states that, while leveraging the vast domestic customer base built through Takkyubin, it is working to further expand in areas where it has strengths, such as automotive, high-tech and food industries, and is strengthening its sales capabilities mainly in Japan, North America, China and Southeast Asia. In January 2026, to support the construction of global supply chains for manufacturers aiming to expand production in India, the Yamato Group opened its largest overseas logistics center. Because revenue from external customers in Japan exceeds 90% of consolidated operating revenue, information by region is omitted.

entries.c1e641d814e7d8c4: Home delivery of small-lot cargo centered on "Takkyubin." Handling volume in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 1,941 million units for Takkyubin, Takkyubin Compact and EAZY (down 1.0% from the previous fiscal year), 451 million units for Nekopos and Kuroneko Yu-Packet (up 15.4%), and 95 million copies for Kuroneko Yu-Mail (down 13.6%). In the related information "Information by product and service," operating revenues from external customers are divided into ¥1,408,896 million for home delivery and ¥456,778 million for others. The company focuses on creating an environment in which sales drivers can devote themselves to facing customers and providing better service, and is advancing the relocation of collection and delivery bases based on regional market potential and the rollout of community-based service bases that offer services beyond sending and receiving Takkyubin. Expanding the provision of the "leave-at-door" service in cooperation with EC operators is also cited as an initiative that contributes to reducing redelivery, making logistics more efficient and reducing greenhouse gas emissions. The company states that although the home delivery market is on an expanding trend along with the growth of EC, the market for individuals and small-lot corporate customers, its base area, is affected by population decline and weak personal consumption, and the profitability of the Takkyubin network is on a declining trend.

entries.ffc93c6e50170d63: This is a reportable segment that provides domestic transport and delivery services centered on TA-Q-BIN to individual and corporate customers. It is carried out mainly by Yamato Transport Co., Ltd., together with Okinawa Yamato Transport Co., Ltd., Yamato Box Charter Co., Ltd., Yamato Multi Charter Co., Ltd., Box Charter Co., Ltd., Sustainable Shared Transport Inc., RH Co., Ltd., Redhorse Corporation, Packcity Japan K.K. and others. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating revenue from external customers was ¥1,557,978 million (up 1.5% from the previous fiscal year), accounting for 83.5% of consolidated operating revenue, with a breakdown of transportation revenue of ¥1,544,122 million, logistics support revenue of ¥47,065 million, other revenue of ¥39,658 million, and elimination of internal sales of -¥72,867 million. Segment profit (operating profit) was ¥2,299 million, an improvement of ¥15,198 million from a loss of -¥12,899 million in the previous fiscal year. Segment assets were ¥970,538 million (including ¥370,128 million for the head office divisions of Yamato Transport Co., Ltd.), and the number of employees was 157,902 (76,551 full-timers and 81,351 part-timers), accounting for 9-tenths of the consolidated number of employees, with capital investment of ¥48,794 million. The company explains that it is promoting expansion of the volume of TA-Q-BIN handled for small-lot corporate and individual customers, which the TA-Q-BIN division serves, and the optimization of pricing in line with added value for large-lot corporate customers, which the corporate division serves. In October 2025, the company revised the filed freight rates for TA-Q-BIN, and in November it began offering the "TA-Q-BIN Same-Day Delivery Service," which delivers parcels received in the morning within the same day, and established new rates for transport within the same prefecture. In transportation, the company is promoting a shift to a transport method in which relay hubs are set on long-distance routes and routes are connected in a relay format, and a modal shift including the use of dedicated freight aircraft.
